extraction.notes: AVB reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO subtotal, so affo fields are null. Core FFO adjustments reproduce $398,687 exactly from FFO of $383,599. Diluted shares printed in full as 140,812,786, shown as 140,812.786 thousands; 383,599/140,812.786 = 2.72 and 398,687/140,812.786 = 2.83, matching reported. The 'Unconsolidated entity activity' line (7,116) is primarily unrealized losses on property technology and sustainability fund investments plus a distribution from an unconsolidated venture; coded investment_gain_loss as the primary component, mixed amount. 'Other real estate activity' (84) is gains on sale of non-operating real estate, coded land_sale_gain_loss (non-depreciable). Income tax benefit and SIP loan reserve and advocacy contributions have no closer category, so coded other. Recurring capex was taken from the Table 1 Capitalized Community Expenditures on the page seq 7 (printed 5): Asset Preservation Capex total of $46,037 thousand for Q1 2026 (Same Store $44,178 + Non-Same Store $1,859). The reconciliation appears on seq 9 and duplicated on seq 33 (printed 20) with identical figures.
